title: The strawberry pie and the Ben Webster-Don Byas rift
summary: Ben never forgot the whole strawberry pie Barefield got; they nicknamed each other Bull and Frog. Ben and Byas, who played billiards in Holland, later fell out.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: She used to make pies and I loved strawberry pie. And she used to make me a whole pie. And I would get a quart of milk and sit there and eat it and wouldn't give Ben any of it. And he never would forget it. Years later he always said, he called me Bull and I named him Frog. And he would say, she made Bull a whole pie. He never did forget that.

Then when he was -- you know, we always came together. I have letters from him now, you know, from when he first went to Europe. And he was telling me how he and Don USED TO PLAY billiards AND HOW. in Holland. He was trying to beat Don at the billard table but Don was a little bit too much for him. But they fell out somewhere along the line because when I went to Europe, which I'll come to later, they were both there and they weren't

very friendly with each other.
But where was I now?
